## What Is an Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) Internship?


ADM's Summer Internship Program is a 12-week paid placement that assigns each intern to a meaningful role within one of 9+ business functions, from grain merchandising and plant operations to finance and marketing. The program includes a National Intern Orientation Week at ADM's Decatur campus (all-inclusive), a formal mentor assignment, leadership lunches with senior executives, and company-sponsored training through LinkedIn Learning. ADM has been recognized as one of Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies (2026), and the intern-specific compensation/benefits rating on Glassdoor is 4.9/5. It is worth pursuing because ADM is one of the four ABCD grain traders that control global agricultural commodity flows, offering exposure to a supply chain no other industry can replicate.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


ADM sets consistent requirements across all intern tracks, with a published 2.8 GPA floor and strict work authorization requirements.


• **Enrollment:** Full-time student pursuing a 4-year degree in a related field


• **GPA:** 2.8 minimum overall (published consistently across all 2026 postings); 3.0 preferred for engineering-heavy tracks


• **Work authorization:** Permanent US work authorization required. ADM cannot sponsor visas for early-career programs (no H-1B, no OPT, no TN)


• **Transportation:** Own transportation required; willing to relocate to assigned ADM location


• **Relocation support:** ADM provides housing and mileage or relocation assistance based on assigned site


• **Immersive Summit (freshmen only):** 3-day pipeline event at Decatur HQ targeting women, Black/African American, and Hispanic/Latino students


### Does ADM Have a GPA Cutoff for Interns?


Yes. ADM publishes a 2.8 minimum GPA consistently across every intern posting verified for this guide (Process Automation, Finance LDP, Data Analyst, Ag Operations). This is a hard floor, not a preference. The Process Automation track adds a 3.0 'preferred' note on top of the 2.8 minimum. Unlike many companies that leave GPA unstated, ADM is transparent about this threshold, which is lower than typical consulting or banking cutoffs but firm.

## What Is the Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) Application and Interview Process Like?


ADM's hiring process is primarily behavioral-interview-driven, with an average time to hire of about 35 days for interns.


1. **Apply online.** Visit ADM's Early Careers page, which routes to the BrassRing portal. Choose a specific function's posting. Immersive Summit applicants (freshmen only) apply to that separate 3-day program.


2. **Optional skills or personality assessment.** Some technical and analytical roles include an online assessment (15% of Glassdoor reviewers report a personality test; 8% a skills test).


3. **Phone or recruiter screen.** Initial conversation assessing basic qualifications and fit for the role.


4. **Panel or one-on-one interview.** Meeting with the hiring manager and team members. Generally behavioral rather than technical for most business tracks. 88% of intern candidates report a positive experience.


5. **Background check and drug test.** Standard pre-employment screening before final offer.


Campus recruiting is ADM's primary channel (67% of intern interviews). Attend career fairs and ADM info sessions at your school for priority consideration. See[ADM's Early Careers page](https://www.adm.com/en-us/culture-and-careers/early-careers/) .

## How Do You Stand Out at ADM?


First, if you are targeting the Grain Merchandising track, understand that ADM is one of only four companies on earth (ADM, Bunge, Cargill, Louis Dreyfus) that control global grain flows. Demonstrating knowledge of commodity origination, basis trading, or hedging mechanics immediately separates you from generic business applicants. Second, pitch a project idea tied to ADM's Human Nutrition segment, which develops specialty ingredients, plant-based proteins, and flavors sold to consumer brands worldwide. Showing awareness of this innovation pipeline in your interview demonstrates you have researched beyond the 'grain company' surface. Third, plan to make the most of National Intern Orientation Week at Decatur, where the entire 100-165 person cohort gathers for cross-functional networking, leadership lunches, and presentations to senior executives.

## FAQ


### Does ADM offer internships?


Yes. ADM runs a formal paid Summer Internship Program placing 100-165 interns per cohort across 9+ business functions at 40+ locations. The program is 12 weeks long, with housing and relocation assistance provided, plus an all-inclusive National Intern Orientation Week.


### When do ADM internship applications open for summer 2027?


Not confirmed as of August 2026. Past cycles show postings appearing between October and March, with some roles posting as late as February. Expect the same broad October-March window for Summer 2027.


### Is ADM internship hiring rolling?


Yes. ADM does not publish fixed closing dates on its internship postings. Every 2026 posting checked closed without a published deadline. Apply as soon as a role in your target function opens for the best chance.


### What GPA does ADM require for an internship?


A 2.8 minimum overall GPA, published consistently across every 2026 posting (Process Automation, Finance, Data Analyst, Ag Operations). The Process Automation track adds a 3.0 preferred note. This is a hard floor.


### Does ADM sponsor visas for interns?


No. ADM's own postings state plainly that the company cannot sponsor visas for early-career programs. Permanent US work authorization is required. ADM files H-1B for full-time professional roles but not for interns.


### How much does an ADM internship pay?


Official range is $21-25/hr across ADM's 2026 postings, dependent on graduation date. Glassdoor's median from 37 reports is $25/hr. ADM also provides housing, relocation assistance, and an all-inclusive National Intern Orientation Week.


### Do ADM interns get return offers?


ADM does not publish a conversion rate. Its postings say interns who show high potential may be offered a returning internship or full-time position, including a path into the 2.5-year Finance Leadership Development Program.


### What is the ADM internship interview like?


Primarily behavioral with an average time to hire of 35 days. Expect a phone screen then a panel interview. Glassdoor rates difficulty at 2.5/5 with 88% of intern candidates reporting positive experience. Campus recruiting accounts for 67% of interviews.
